estimand: out-of-sample, pooled two-way (coin + hour-of-day) fixed-effects within-transform forecast of next-hour and next-24-hour realized volatility on the broad frozen ironflow_bulk panel, testing whether funding features (signed funding rate, trailing abs_funding trail, trailing RV24/RV168, mark/oracle premium dislocation, MA deviation) improve QLIKE over a realized-volatility-only baseline once coin and hour fixed effects are removed, and whether any improvement clears the frozen 2% relative QLIKE materiality floor with Holm-adjusted uncertainty. Outcome-blind: no outcome summaries inspected before this freeze.

label_construct.description: next-hour RV = squared close-to-close log return over hour t+1; next-24h RV = sum of squared close-to-close log returns over hours t+1..t+24; computed per coin from candles_1h close

universe.note: panel uses the intersection of coins present in candles_1h, funding, and open_interest; present-day survivors not substituted for the historical universe; no future information in coin selection.

features.signed_funding_rate: latest funding observation whose availability timestamp is <= origin hour t, retaining sign separately
features.abs_funding_trail: trailing rolling mean of abs(funding_rate), train-only thresholds
features.rv24: trailing 24-hour realized volatility (sum of squared close-to-close log returns) ending at t
features.rv168: trailing 168-hour realized volatility ending at t
features.premium_dislocation: mark_price / oracle_price - 1 from open_interest, contemporaneous alignment
features.ma_deviation: close_t / 24-hour trailing moving average of close - 1, EMA computed from prior/current fully closed bars only
features.normalization: train-only means and standard deviations; expanding train-only thresholds; no full-sample quantiles; no future information

baseline.description: pooled two-way (coin + hour-of-day) fixed-effects within-transform regression of target RV on trailing RV24 (and RV168) only; no funding features

candidate.description: same pooled two-way FE within-transform as baseline, plus signed funding rate, abs_funding trail, RV24/RV168, mark/oracle premium dislocation, MA deviation

design.test_blocks: chronological non-overlapping 168h blocks over the post-train test span

inference: Diebold-Mariano HAC on daily loss differential

uncertainty.dm_hac: HAC-standardized Diebold-Mariano test on paired daily loss differential (candidate - baseline)
uncertainty.cluster_robust_cr1: cluster-robust standard errors by coin for FE coefficients
uncertainty.driscoll_kraay_hac: Driscoll-Kraay HAC for cross-sectional and serial dependence

verdict_rule.NOT_SUPPORTED_iff: floor not met OR uncertainty does not support improvement
verdict_rule.INCONCLUSIVE_iff: evaluation cannot be completed or fidelity blocker
verdict_rule.null_is_valid: a null is a valid, publishable negative result that closes Half 1 at broad scale

materiality_floor.definition: a +1 sample-SD funding shock must move QLIKE by >= 2% relative to baseline
